thread:
maria: Quick sync — prepping mpt-6b-v2 for Dedicated serving. Need a short readiness pass: weights path, tokenizer quirks, config validation, and quant strategy (AWQ / GPTQ / FP8). Who can pick this up?
kevin: I uploaded the weights to s3: s3://redwood-artifacts/models/mpt-6b-v2/weights_v2.tgz (sha256: 9f7a3b2e1c4d5a6b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b). Permissions set to redwood-ml-team.
sophie: Tokenizer note: the original tokenizer.json includes a few byte-level BPE tokens that the tokenizer lib maps differently (leading █/Ġ variants). For inference we should freeze token IDs. Tokenizer file: s3://redwood-artifacts/models/mpt-6b-v2/tokenizer.json — I saw 3 tokens with duplicate mappings in the debug dump.
kevin: thanks — I also put a tokenizer_patch.json at s3://.../tokenizer_patch.json that remaps the dup IDs to the canonical ones.
devon: Quick config ask: can you confirm we want kv_cache: true, seq_len: 2048, dtype: float16, and batching: continuous? Also what's the default quant_profile we try first?
maria: Yes to kv_cache true and seq_len 2048. Start with awq-4bit baseline (awq-v1) for throughput, then run gptq-4bit and fp8 candidates for accuracy tradeoffs. We'll need calibration data for AWQ.
allen: I can run calibration. Which dataset? And where do we record calib artifacts?
sophie: Use calib set: s3://redwood-calib/mpt-6b-v2/calib-1k.jsonl (1k lines, mixed instruction+doc). Output calib stats to s3://redwood-calib/mpt-6b-v2/awq-stats/.
ops-bot: CI | model-serve-check triggered for thread 1835054321 — job #5427 queued. :gear:
kevin: small config snippet I'm pushing to the repo in the PR, paste here for quick sanity:```json
{
  "model_name": "mpt-6b-v2",
  "weights_path": "s3://redwood-artifacts/models/mpt-6b-v2/weights_v2.tgz",
  "tokenizer_path": "s3://redwood-artifacts/models/mpt-6b-v2/tokenizer.json",
  "seq_len": 2048,
  "kv_cache": true,
  "dtype": "float16",
  "quant_profile": "awq-v1"
}
```
maria: Looks good. One more: add a flag `force_token_id_fix: true` until tokenizer patch lands in upstream.
allen: I'll run calib and start AWQ job tonight. Estimated run time ~3h. I'll upload results + metrics (perplexity, exact-match on eval set) to the awq-stats path.
devon: For approvals: please include a short table in the PR with delta vs fp16 for EM/F1 on the QA dev set and a latency/cost estimate. We'll approve if AWQ drop <= 1.5% EM and latency gain >= 1.8x vs fp16.
sophie: Early numbers from a small run: AWQ-4bit ∆EM = -1.2%, latency ≈ 2.1x; GPTQ-4bit ∆EM = -0.6% but ~1.6x latency. FP8 (simulated) ∆EM = -0.4% latency ≈ 1.9x.
maria: Good — that suggests AWQ is within threshold but we should run full calib + eval. Allen please attach raw eval outputs and the eval prompts.
allen: Will do. Also flagging tokenizer regression test: added a quick unit to ensure token ids for top-50 tokens are stable. Patch in PR.
kevin: PR link: https://git.redwood.redwood/p/mpt-serving/pull/487 — contains config + tokenizer patch + unit.
maria: Ordering of deploy: canary on Dedicated first with quantized model and fallback to fp16 in the policy. ops-team — please set canary = 5% traffic.
ops-bot: deploy | canary job submitted for mpt-6b-v2 quantized candidate. Monitor dashboard: /dash/model/mpt-6b-v2.
devon: Ping me once AWQ stats uploaded; I'll run the approval checklist.
allen: Uploaded awq-stats csv + eval jsonl at s3://redwood-calib/mpt-6b-v2/awq-stats/run-2026-03-16/ (includes perf.json, eval_results.json).
sophie: Quick sanity: eval_results.json shows EM 82.1% (fp16 83.3%), so ∆EM = -1.2%. Looks consistent.
maria: Ok team — looks good. Action items: 
- [ ] allen: finalize calib run + upload raw logs
- [ ] kevin: merge tokenizer patch after approvals
- [ ] devon: run approval checklist when artifacts are in
- [ ] ops: set canary 5% and monitor latency/cost
:thumbsup:
kevin: LGTM, assigning reviewers now.
maria: Thanks everyone — we'll regroup async unless blockers show up.
